hero.title: About EEC Cologne Church
hero.subtitle: Welcome! We are a community rooted in faith, love, and service. Join us in our journey of worship, fellowship, and spiritual growth.

missionVision.title: Our Mission & Vision
missionVision.subtitle: To spread the love of Christ through worship, community service, and personal discipleship. We envision a church where everyone feels welcome, supported, and empowered to grow in faith.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: Guiding people to live a life rooted in faith and service.

community.description: Building a welcoming and supportive environment for all.

growth.description: Encouraging spiritual and personal growth for every member.

pastorSection.title: Pastor Yonatan Aklilu
pastorSection.subtitle: Our pastor has served the community for over 20 years, guiding members in faith and personal growth. His message is one of love, hope, and dedication.

historySection.title: Our History
historySection.subtitle: Founded in 1995, EEC Cologne Church has grown from a small gathering to a thriving community. We have served thousands of families and individuals, providing worship, education, and community support.
